answer: SELECT COUNT(*) AS variable_spend_buyers FROM buyers WHERE buyer_risk_profile->>'spend_pattern' = 'Variable'

SELECT p."ProdCat" AS product_category, COUNT(DISTINCT (p."ProdCat", p."Subcategory", p."ListingAge", p."SellerPointer")) AS active_listings, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.communication_details->>'lang_pattern_type' = 'Consistent') AS consistent_lang_txns, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.communication_details->>'lang_pattern_type' = 'Suspicious') AS suspicious_lang_txns, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.communication_details->>'lang_pattern_type' = 'Variable') AS variable_lang_txns, COUNT(DISTINCT b."AcqCode") FILTER (WHERE (b.buyer_risk_profile->>'behavior_consistency_scr')::numeric < 50 AND split_part(b.buyer_risk_profile->>'risk_dollar_ratio', ' ', 1)::numeric > 0.1) AS suspicious_buyers FROM products p LEFT JOIN transaction_products tp ON tp."ProdCat" = p."ProdCat" AND tp."Subcategory" = p."Subcategory" AND tp."ListingAge" = p."ListingAge" AND tp."SellerPointer" = p."SellerPointer" LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t."EventCode" = tp."EventLink" LEFT JOIN communications c ON c."EventLink" = t."EventCode" LEFT JOIN buyers b ON b."AcqCode" = t."AcqLink" WHERE (p.product_availability->>'qty_avail')::numeric > 0 GROUP BY p."ProdCat" ORDER BY active_listings DESC
note: 'Active listing' taken as qty_avail > 0 (all listings qualify); Suspicious Buyer thresholds not defined in knowledge: used behavior_consistency_scr < 50 and risk_dollar_ratio > 0.1; 'metrics related to' interpreted as counts.

answer: SELECT "PlatCode", "PlatName", ROUND(((0.4 * (platform_compliance->>'vuln_inst_count')::numeric + 0.3 * (platform_compliance->>'sec_event_count')::numeric + 0.3 * NULLIF(regexp_replace("RepScore", '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric) / 100), 4) AS mrs FROM markets ORDER BY mrs DESC NULLS LAST
note: RepScore stored as text like '$98.60 '; parsed. 387 markets have NULL RepScore so MRS is NULL; placed last.

answer: SELECT "EventLink" AS thread_id, ROUND((communication_details->>'keyword_match_count')::numeric / NULLIF((communication_details->>'msg_count_total')::numeric, 0), 3) AS ssd FROM communications ORDER BY ssd DESC NULLS LAST

WITH ap AS (SELECT "SellerPointer", AVG((product_availability->>'price_amt')::numeric) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY 1), rc AS (SELECT "VendorLink", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "RouteComplex"='Simple') AS simple_routes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "RouteComplex"='Medium') AS medium_routes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "RouteComplex"='Complex') AS complex_routes FROM transactions GROUP BY 1) SELECT v."SellerKey", v."CompletedTxns" * ap.avg_price / NULLIF(v."DaysActive", 0) AS plr, COALESCE(rc.simple_routes,0) AS simple_routes, COALESCE(rc.medium_routes,0) AS medium_routes, COALESCE(rc.complex_routes,0) AS complex_routes FROM vendors v LEFT JOIN ap ON ap."SellerPointer" = v."SellerKey" LEFT JOIN rc ON rc."VendorLink" = v."SellerKey" ORDER BY plr DESC NULLS LAST
note: successful_txns=CompletedTxns, average_price=avg product price_amt for vendor, days_active=DaysActive; route complexity given as per-vendor transaction counts.

answer: WITH b AS (SELECT "AcqCode", NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY split_part(buyer_risk_profile->>'risk_dollar_ratio',' ',1)::numeric) AS tile FROM buyers WHERE buyer_risk_profile->>'risk_dollar_ratio' IS NOT NULL), tx AS (SELECT b.tile, t."EventCode", t."CrossBorder", CASE WHEN cs."AnonLevel"::numeric >= 7 THEN 'High' WHEN cs."AnonLevel"::numeric >= 4 THEN 'Medium' WHEN cs."AnonLevel" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Low' END AS anon FROM b LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t."AcqLink" = b."AcqCode" LEFT JOIN connection_security cs ON cs."TxnPointer" = t."EventCode") SELECT CASE b.tile WHEN 1 THEN 'Low' WHEN 2 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS brdr_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT b."AcqCode") AS buyer_count, (SELECT ROUND(AVG((x."CrossBorder" = 1)::int)::numeric, 4) FROM tx x WHERE x.tile = b.tile AND x."EventCode" IS NOT NULL) AS cross_border_share, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tx x WHERE x.tile = b.tile AND x.anon = 'High') AS high_anonymity_sessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tx x WHERE x.tile = b.tile AND x.anon = 'Medium') AS medium_anonymity_sessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tx x WHERE x.tile = b.tile AND x.anon = 'Low') AS low_anonymity_sessions FROM b GROUP BY b.tile ORDER BY b.tile
note: Buckets = terciles (NTILE 3) of stored risk_dollar_ratio; session anonymity derived from numeric AnonLevel (1-10): >=7 High, >=4 Medium, else Low.

answer: SELECT cs."TxnPointer" AS session_id, split_part(cs."Threat_handle_rate", ' ', 1)::numeric AS threat_handling_rate, b."AuthLevel" AS buyer_auth_level FROM connection_security cs JOIN transactions t ON t."EventCode" = cs."TxnPointer" LEFT JOIN buyers b ON b."AcqCode" = t."AcqLink" ORDER BY threat_handling_rate DESC NULLS LAST
note: THR taken from stored Threat_handle_rate text; buyer auth level via transaction's buyer.

answer: SELECT m."PlatCode", m."PlatName", m."OperStatus", COUNT(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'escalation_tier_stat' = 'Level3') AS tier3_escalation_cases, COUNT(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'severity_level_stat' = 'Critical') AS critical_alerts, COUNT(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'severity_level_stat' = 'High') AS high_alerts, COUNT(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'severity_level_stat' = 'Medium') AS medium_alerts, COUNT(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'severity_level_stat' = 'Low') AS low_alerts FROM markets m LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t."PlatformKey" = m."PlatCode" LEFT JOIN alerts a ON a."EventTag" = t."EventCode" WHERE (m.platform_compliance->>'vuln_inst_count')::numeric < 10 AND (m.platform_compliance->>'protection_meas_count')::numeric > 15 GROUP BY m."PlatCode", m."PlatName", m."OperStatus"
note: Tier-3 = escalation_tier_stat 'Level3'; alerts linked to platform through transactions.

answer: SELECT "RouteComplex" AS route_complexity, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions GROUP BY "RouteComplex" ORDER BY transaction_count DESC

SELECT anonymity_level, ROUND(AVG("OpSecMetric")::numeric, 2) AS avg_opsec_score FROM (SELECT "OpSecMetric", CASE WHEN "AnonLevel"::numeric >= 7 THEN 'High' WHEN "AnonLevel"::numeric >= 4 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS anonymity_level FROM connection_security WHERE "AnonLevel" IS NOT NULL) s GROUP BY anonymity_level ORDER BY CASE anonymity_level WHEN 'High' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
note: AnonLevel is numeric 1-10; mapped to High (>=7) / Medium (>=4) / Low.
